tools.name: ground_truth_ask
tools.description: Current, verifiable real-world facts: cited, time-stamped public facts for anywhere on Earth: weather, river levels, floods, earthquakes, disasters, air quality, US weather alerts (road closures, power outages, burn bans report 'not connected' until sources exist). Every answer has fact, place, time

tools.name: ground_truth_sources
tools.description: List every Ground Truth topic, the public source behind it and whether that source is connected yet. Shows what Ground Truth can answer and which agency each fact comes from. Takes no input. Free, read-only, no sign-up.

tools.name: countersign_stamp
tools.description: Use when you need a signed check, by code that did not make the work, of work you or another agent produced (a report, calculation, summary, filing draft or code) before relying on it or handing it on. Countersign re-computes arithmetic, looks up quotes and values in the cited sources, opens links a

tools.name: countersign_verify
tools.description: Confirm that a Countersign stamp someone shows you is real before you trust it. Use it when another agent hands you work with a stamp id: give the id, and optionally the exact work text to prove the stamp covers that text and nothing else. Returns the logged stamp, whether its signature is valid and

tools.name: countersign_log
tools.description: Read the public, append-only log of Countersign stamps: entries after a sequence number, in order, plus the head hash, entry count and public key so you can check signatures yourself. Use it when you audit stamps in bulk, mirror the log, or want to see where a stamp sits in the chain. Free, read-onl

tools.name: agent_readiness_audit
tools.description: Use when you or your user want a site or a code repo ready for agent traffic. Send a domain (example.com) or a public GitHub repo (https://github.com/owner/repo). Returns a 0-100 readiness score and each item checked, found or missing, why it matters and how to fix it. Site: /llms.txt, A2A agent car

tools.name: certified_lookup
tools.description: LLPRO Certified public register lookup. Send a subject id (a product, service or agent id, lowercase letters, digits, . _ : -, up to 96 characters) to get issued, not_found, revoked or expired for it; send nothing to get the whole register (counts, head hash, criteria hash and the events, up to 200)

tools.name: agent_identity_check
tools.description: Does this agent's card agree with the domain that served it and the keys that domain publishes? Send an agent card URL (https) or a domain. We read the card through a safe fetcher and check: required fields; that the domain the card names is the host it was served from; that the operator publishes t

tools.name: witness_record
tools.description: Witness a deal event. Send deal_id, party_id, event_type, content_hash (SHA-256 hex of the content, never the content), your Ed25519 public_key and your sig (base64 signature over the canonical JSON of {content_hash, deal_id, event_type, party_id, type:'witness-event', v:1}). Get back a receipt sign

tools.name: page_snapshot_signed
tools.description: What did this public web page show, and when? Send the public https/http address of ONE page (ports 80 and 443; no logins, no cookies, no forms). Get back a screenshot (PNG, 1280 px wide, full page up to 4000 px tall), the visible text, the final address after redirects, the HTTP status, and a note

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "trust?via=mcp-registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agent_identity_check, page_snapshot_signed · Private data: countersign_log, witness_record · Public sink: ground_truth_ask, countersign_stamp, agent_readiness_audit, certified_lookup, agent_identity_check, witness_record, page_snapshot_signed.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agent_identity_check, page_snapshot_signed · Private data: countersign_log, witness_record · Public sink: ground_truth_ask, countersign_stamp, agent_readiness_audit, certified_lookup, agent_identity_check, witness_record, page_snapshot_signed

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
